scope: Substantive refresh of a 700 word post at its existing URL

observations.summary: Removed an unsupported 'fraction of the time' trenchless claim, a utility bill savings claim, an 'inspection services' link pointing to /service-areas, generic trust copy, a seasonal tip referring to summer rains, and internal links presented as sources.
observations.inference_limit: Links now point to existing service pages; no new service claimed.

observations.summary: Owners own and are responsible for the lateral from the public main connection to the building, including cleaning, repairs, backflow devices and overflow costs; video inspection required at escrow or sale, remodels increasing fixture units or ADU connections, new buildings, and more than two overflows in 12 months.
observations.inference_limit: Santa Cruz County Sanitation District guidance.

observations.summary: By default the seller is responsible for inspection and repairs before escrow closes; only licensed plumbing contractors inspect; defects include fractured or deteriorated pipe, roots, infiltration, out of round pipe, sags, and Orangeburg, asbestos cement or cast iron; repairs need a no-cost sanitary sewer connection permit and inspection before cover; cleanout required before close of escrow; laterals under 20 years old inspected at install may be exempt.
observations.inference_limit: FAQ dated 2019-09-13; post advises confirming current rules.

observations.summary: With County approval, the buyer may assume required lateral repairs and device installations (cleanout, any required backflow device) and must complete them within 90 calendar days of approval; the seller still provides the inspection video, County-reviewed inspection form and County comments.
observations.inference_limit: Alternative to the default pre-closing requirement; requires agreement of both parties and County approval.

observations.summary: Private lateral maintenance has always been the property owner's responsibility, including the portion under the city street and the connection to the main; lateral should have an accessible cleanout; owner liable for spills from building sewer failure; time of sale rules on the separate lateral ordinance page.
Hours, free quotes and flat-rate pricing restated; all linked services and posts exist.
observations.inference_limit: Only confirmed business facts are restated.
